_readme: Concord's SELLING prices per pair (GST incl., coating included) shown in the Lens Finder beside the supplier cost — the 15 Sep 2026 staff sheet. 'tiers': the first tier whose 'match' snippet appears in supplier+brand+lens name gives the base price by index (category limits a tier to one lens kind). 'addons' add to the base when the snippet appears in the lens name, material or coating — BluePro +$50, photochromic +$130 — and the special 'grind' key adds the made-to-order surcharge on single-vision GRIND rows only (multifocal tiers already include it). 'blank_names' suppress a price (polarised is priced off the sunglasses list; MiyoSmart has its own). Tint +$50 (grind only) is not modelled. Index keys are strings like "1.60". The old Hoya keys (design_prices / sv_tiers / surcharge) still work if you ever need them.
